original_add_commit_message: Add ETH spot ETF flow compressed raw history dataset

strict_replay_evidence.reason_decoded_sha_not_verified: Strict base64 decoding fails before gzip decompression and full decoded CSV hashing can occur.

scientific_conclusion: The point-in-time ETH ETF archive is unusable for confirmatory or discovery inference because the byte-identical original/current source fails strict decoding. The historical QA PASS claim is not sufficient to override executable provenance failure.

candidate_disposition.future_new_source_rule: A separately versioned independently provenance-valid source may support a new research contract, but it must not be represented as recovery of this point-in-time archive or used to hindsight-rescore the frozen lane.
